title: Introduction to Soil Science - 2nd Edition
description: This textbook introduces readers to introductory soil science topics including the physical, chemical, and biological properties of soils; soil formation, classification, and global distribution; soil health, soils and humanity, and sustainable land management. The second edition brings forward new information about soil water and soil chemistry alongside updates to the core chapters.
authors: Amber Anderson - Author / Rivka Fidel - Author
